evidence.claim: Traydstream provides an AI-powered trade execution, financing, and risk management platform for banks, financial institutions, and corporates, supporting specific modules like TraydCheck, TraydAccess, TraydAnalytics, TraydConnect, TraydFund, and TraydGuard (Traydstream Solutions).
The platform processes over $350bn+ in transactions across more than 70 countries and supports over 800+ document types (Traydstream Home).

TraydCheck automates verification of trade documents against UCP 600 and ISBP 745 international standards with over 400,000 rule permutations using built-in legal and compliance checks (YouTube Video and TraydCheck Solution).

It integrates third-party compliance providers for real-time sanction screening, dual-use goods checks, and transaction banking anti-money laundering (TBML) detection, achieving up to 99.98% discrepancy accuracy (Financial IT and Traydstream & Surecomp Partnership).

Traydstream features native integration with leading global financial systems, partnering with providers like Surecomp to connect its AI engine directly into the RIVO platform (Traydstream & Surecomp Partnership).

The core engine utilizes a cloud-native architecture built entirely on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Microsoft's Vision platform for high-performance Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to convert unstructured data (YouTube Video and Fintech Futures).

Deployed at enterprise scale globally by institutions like Deutsche Bank and Standard Bank Group, the platform processes millions of documents securely with automated backend integrations (Traydstream & Deutsche Bank Strategic Partnership and Traydstream for Banks).

In 2026, Traydstream expanded its roadmap to focus heavily on agentic AI operating models capable of autonomously interpreting documents, validating discrepancies, and running compliance assessments (Traydstream News).
The platform rolled out its 2.0 version featuring enhanced speed, updated machine learning classification models, and augmented workability checks across all underlying trade papers (Financial IT).

The company reports its AI-powered platform automates and digitizes trade document checking by validating structured and unstructured data against more than 250,000 global trade and compliance rules, specifically verifying transaction terms for letters of credit and collections.

The company reports its modular solutions include TraydCheck for automated document verification, TraydAccess for managing trade finance asset distribution, and TraydLC Review which targets specific innovations in export letter of credit workability, admin configuration, and mismatch detection.
